τῶν ἰδίων αὐτοῦ → *of his friends* follows rule 20's model directly (`τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ` → *of his will*): the expressed genitive takes *his*, the article's determiner slot is thereby emptied, and *of … friends* stays with the nominal token. The competing reading is rule 102/49, which would hand the supplied *friends* to the article and leave ἰδίων empty; it is weaker here because rule 102's examples all show the article carrying a determiner of its own, which displacement has removed.
μηδένα carries the whole discontinuous *not … any* under rule 69, no separate negator standing in the clause.
